title: T-25 (2026-11-13): a failed join followed at once by hosting must not leave the host on the 'Waiting for all players' screen. The client-session end of the failed join (MPClient disconnect -> TimeSync.EndClientSessionHold) must leave NO early-release note, the host's BeginStartupHold must hold normally (never SKIP), and the host's own release must end the hold AND lift the host's movement soft-hold. Host-only: the client instance is launched (the rig's minimum is 2) but stays idle in the main menu. NO save.
preconditions: Dev build with the T-25 fix. Fixture save1 (host melaus). Nothing listens on localhost:7799. PREMISE: the bug needed the host's hold to begin within 90 s of the failed join's disconnect (the old note's validity window); step 5 asserts it with the host's '[TimeSync] Host startup hold begins Ns after this machine's client session ended' line, which TimeSync logs only when that gap is under 90 s - if the save loads slower the step FAILs as 'premise not met', not as a pass. The client's own early-release path (release before its hold, round-18/36) is not exercised here: no existing scenario covers it and no lever forces that ordering.
oracles_absent: \[TimeSync\] Startup release received BEFORE the hold began
\[TimeSync\] Early-release note dropped \(host begins its own hold\)

expect_log.regex: \[TimeSync\] Startup release with no hold standing \(client session ended\)

steps.note: the failed join's disconnect ends the client session with no hold standing; before T-25 this logged 'Startup release received BEFORE the hold began' and left a 90 s note

expect_log.regex: \[TimeSync\] Host startup hold begins \d+s after this machine's client session ended

steps.note: premise (hold began under 90 s after the failed join), then the host's own release ends the hold and lifts the movement soft-hold
